name: WeTrakr
description: Scrobbles what you watch to WeTrakr and keeps your watched history in sync, per Emby user. Play, pause and stop are reported as they happen; manual mark-as-played is mirrored; watched history can be imported from and sent to WeTrakr, automatically if you like. Connect with a short code, no password shared.
overview: Scrobble to WeTrakr and sync watched history, per Emby user.
